passive.name: Subsume
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. At the start of battle or for every **4** instance(s) of Follow-Up ATK the wearer uses, the wearer gains "Umbra Devourer," lasting for **3** turn(s). While the wearer holds "Umbra Devourer," increases ATK by **40/50/60/70/80%** and increases the DMG taken by all enemies by **20/22.5/25/27.5/30%**. Effects of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Hrunting
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **16/20/24/28/32%**. When entering combat, if the allies' Skill Points limit is **6** or higher, increases the wearer's ATK by **40/50/60/70/80%**. After each use of the wearer's Skill, increases the wearer's ATK by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%**, stacking up to **4** time(s).

passive.name: Mental Training
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **20/23/26/29/32%**. For every debuff on the enemy target, the wearer's CRIT DMG dealt against this target additionally increases by **8/9/10/11/12%**, stacking up to **3** times. When using Ultimate to attack the enemy target, the wearer receives the "Disputation" effect, which increases DMG dealt by **36/42/48/54/60%** and enables their Follow-Up ATKs to ignore **24/28/32/36/40%** of the target's DEF. This effect lasts for **2** turns.

passive.name: Chase
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **8/10/12/14/16%**, and increases their CRIT Rate against enemies with HP percentage **50%** or less by an extra **8/10/12/14/16%**. When the wearer defeats an enemy, their ATK is increased by **20/25/30/35/40%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Persistence
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **24/28/32/36/40%**. The Skill DMG and Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by the wearer increase by **24/28/32/36/40%**.

passive.name: Record
passive.text: Increases the wearer's ATK by **16/20/24/28/32%**. If there are 2 or fewer enemies on the field, increases wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: CRIT Rate (Until 100% with buffs) > CRIT DMG > ATK%
tracePriority: Projection Magecraft (A2) > Guardian (A6) > Hero of Justice (A4)

entries.name: Kanshou and Bakuya
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword
entries.text: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals Quantum DMG equal to **360%** of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy. After using Skill in the "Circuit Connection" state, the current turn does not end, and the DMG dealt by Archer's Skill increases by **100%**. This effect can stack up to **2** time(s), lasting until he exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After actively using Skill **5** time(s) or when Skill Points are insufficient to use Skill again, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After all enemy targets have been defeated in each wave, exits the "Circuit Connection" state.

entries.name: Unlimited Blade Works
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **1000%** of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy and gains **2** point(s) of Charge, up to a maximum of **4**.

entries.name: Mind's Eye (True)
entries.text: After Archer's teammates attack enemy targets, Archer consumes 1 Charge and immediately launches Follow-Up ATK on the primary target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to **200%** of Archer's ATK and recovering 1 Skill Point. If the target is defeated before this Follow-Up ATK is launched, the Follow-Up ATK will be directed at one random enemy instead.

entries.name: Clairvoyance
entries.text: Immediately attacks enemies. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to **200%** of Archer's ATK to all enemies and gains **1** point(s) of Charge.

entries.name: Projection Magecraft
entries.text: When Archer is on the field, increases the maximum Skill Point limit by **2**.

entries.name: Hero of Justice
entries.text: When Archer enters combat, gains **1** point(s) of Charge.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.text: After allies gain a Skill Point, if there are **4** Skill Points or more, increases Archer's CRIT DMG by **120%** for **1** turn(s).

entries.name: The Unreached Dream
entries.text: After using Skill 3 time(s) within one turn, recovers 2 Skill Point(s) for allies.

entries.name: The Unfulfilled Happiness
entries.text: When using Ultimate, reduces the enemy target's Quantum RES by 20%, and applies Quantum Weakness to it, lasting for 2 turn(s).

entries.name: The Untamed Will
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: The Unsung Life
entries.text: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by 150%.

entries.name: The Nameless Watch
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: The Endless Pilgrimage
entries.text: When the turn starts, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. The maximum number of stacks allowed for the DMG boost effect provided by this unit's Skill increases by 1. The Skill DMG dealt ignores 20% of DEF.
